title: Understanding the Role of Coefficients in Linear Regression
text: In a linear regression model, each coefficient represents the change in the dependent variable for a one-unit change in the corresponding independent variable, holding all other variables constant.

title: Focus on the Coefficient of t2d
text: The coefficient \(\hat{\theta}_2\) is associated with the variable \(x_2\), which represents whether an individual has type $$2$$ diabetes. Consider what a change in \(x_2\) from $$0$$ to $$1$$ implies.

hintAnswer: \hat{\theta}_2 is the predicted increase in blood sugar for someone who has type $$2$$ diabetes relative to someone who does not have type $$2$$ diabetes holding soda drinking status constant.
title: Interpreting \(\hat{\theta}_2\)
text: What does \(\hat{\theta}_2\) tell us about the relationship between type $$2$$ diabetes and blood sugar levels?
